Description: Primary objective: advance the ritual while maintaining control of the battlefield. Prefer control over raw damage; preserve Dimension Door/Teleport escape options. Phase 1: Slow/Telekinesis. Phase 2: isolate with Forcecage and Banishment. Use Chain Lightning when multiple PCs are exposed or a finishing blow is available. Counterspell key ritual-interrupting magic.

Actions.name: Claws
Actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage; target makes DC 14 Constitution save, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much on success.

Actions.name: Teleport
Actions.text: Teleport, along with equipment worn/carried, up to 60 ft. to an unoccupied space it can see.

Traits.name: Threaded Awareness
Traits.text: 1/Combat. When Corvane fails a saving throw, roll a d4 and add it to the result.

Description: Protective controller and social wildcard. Stay near the party's vulnerable member and spend reactions to reduce burst damage. Use control spells to create openings for the Pact rather than chasing damage.

Actions.name: Blade
Actions.text: +7 to hit, 1d8 + 4 piercing; +1d8 psychic if target is affected by one of Corvane's spells.

LegendaryActions.name: Quiet Adjustment
LegendaryActions.text: At end of another creature's turn, Corvane moves up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

BonusActions.name: Thread Step
BonusActions.text: 2/Day. Teleport 20 feet to a visible space.

Reactions.name: Interpose Intention
Reactions.text: When an ally within 30 feet is hit, reduce the damage by 2d6 + 3.

Traits.name: Nimble Escape
Traits.text: Take Disengage or Hide as a Bonus Action.

Description: Skirmisher and nuisance. Throw cloak onto another creature when useful; use decoys and smoke to break line of sight. Surrenders quickly if isolated; carries a cheap knife, travel food, a few coins, and Corvane's business card.

Actions.name: Scimitar (2 attk)
Actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage; if the attack roll has Advantage, add 1d4 slashing damage.

Actions.name: Shortbow (2 attk)
Actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage; if the attack roll has Advantage, add 1d4 piercing damage.

Reactions.name: Redirect Attack
Reactions.text: When a creature Clyrm can see makes an attack roll against Clyrm, choose a Small or Medium ally within 5 feet; Clyrm and that ally swap places and the ally becomes the target.

Traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
Traits.text: When making an attack, has Advantage on the attack roll.

Traits.name: Master Tactic
Traits.text: At the start of combat, Erasmus chooses when he acts in the initiative order after all other creatures have rolled initiative.

Description: BIP field leader. Protects the Supervisor early, marks a high-value target, and uses the Master Tactic timing to coordinate the Pact. Do not retreat until at least one BIP member has fallen. Iron Ring 2/day.

Actions.name: Greatsword (2)
Actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage; target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than Erasmus until end of its next turn.

Only 1 attack if using "I'm Right Here"

Actions.name: I'm Right Here
Actions.text: A creature Erasmus can see within 5 ft. that can hear him must succeed on DC 15 Wisdom save or use its Reaction, if available, to attack Erasmus. If it attacks, an ally within 30 ft. can make a weapon attack against it (no action required).

Actions.name: Iron Ring
Actions.text: 2/day. Teleport to the Cyst if not in it; if in the Cyst, teleport to a place he has visited.

LegendaryActions.name: Playtime's Over
LegendaryActions.text: A High Command member within 60 ft of Erasmus that can hear him can use their villain action even if they already used it.

BonusActions.name: Mark
BonusActions.text: Choose a creature within 60 ft.; until start of next turn, first time an ally deals damage to marked creature, it takes an extra 3 (1d6) damage.

BonusActions.name: Reposition
BonusActions.text: Erasmus and each ally within 60 ft. that can hear him move up to 5 ft. without provoking opportunity attacks.

Traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
Traits.text: When Avalla makes an attack, she has Advantage on the attack roll.

Traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
Traits.text: Advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and supernatural effects.

Description: Battlefield controller and anti-caster. Stay protected behind Erasmus/Cloak. Use Iron Terror to disrupt formation; Spellcasting Feedback punishes the party for trying to answer her with magic. Iron Ring 2/day; Escape Ring triggers at 0 HP if available.

Actions.name: Lightning Lash
Actions.text: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) lightning; Avalla can move target up to 15 ft.

Actions.name: Iron Terror
Actions.text: 1/day; 4th-level spell. 30-foot cone; DC 15 Wisdom save. Fail: 21 (6d6) psychic and frightened of each High Command member for 1 minute (save ends end of turn).

LegendaryActions.name: Promised Storm
LegendaryActions.text: Fires a lightning bolt at creature she can see within 90 ft. Bolt leaps from that target to up to 2 others within 30 ft of the first. DC 15 DEX save, taking 4d10 lightning damage on failed, or half on success.

BonusActions.name: Iron Shakles
BonusActions.text: 1/day; 3rd-level spell, Concentration. Animated iron chains fill a 15-foot square within 60 ft. for 1 minute. Entering/starting turn there: DC 15 Dex save or Restrained; save ends at start of next turn. Restrained creature takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning at end of each turn.

BonusActions.name: Iron Ring
BonusActions.text: 2/day. Teleport to/from the Cyst as described in the stat block.

Reactions.name: Escape Ring
Reactions.text: When Avalla isn't in the Cyst and an ally she can see within 60 ft. drops to 0 HP, teleport to the Cyst with each willing ally within 60 ft. who isn't incapacitated.

Reactions.name: Spellcasting Feedback
Reactions.text: When a creature within 60 ft. casts a spell, it taps into Avalla's mind. It can choose to take 1d6 psychic damage per spell level or let the spell fail; if it fails, the caster's spell slot is expended and action is wasted.

Traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
Traits.text: When Cloak makes an attack, she has Advantage on the attack roll.

Description: Ambusher/protector. Start hidden if possible, use poisoned Shortswords to pressure one target, and use the reaction to punish anyone who attacks her allies. Iron Ring 2/day.

Actions.name: Shortsword
Actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing + 3 (1d6) poison; target poisoned until start of Cloak's next turn.

Actions.name: Light Crossbow
Actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 5) piercing; if target has not taken a turn since end of Cloak's last turn, add 7 (2d6) piercing.

LegendaryActions.name: Assassin's Strike
LegendaryActions.text: Moves up to her speed and makes Shortsword attack. On hit, deals 6d10 piercing instead of normal damage, and it does NOT inflict poisoned. On miss, deals half damage.

BonusActions.name: Iron Ring
BonusActions.text: 2/day. Teleport to/from the Cyst as described in the stat block.

Reactions.name: You Should've Been Watching Me
Reactions.text: When a creature within 5 ft. hits one of Cloak's allies with an attack, Cloak makes a Shortsword attack against the attacker; if it hits, the ally and attacker can be swapped.

Traits.name: Supernatural Resistance
Traits.text: Advantage on saving throws against powers, spells, and supernatural effects.

Traits.name: Evasion
Traits.text: When subjected to a Dex save for half damage, take no damage on success and half on failure.

Traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
Traits.text: When Qar makes an attack, he has Advantage on the attack roll.

Description: Mobile skirmisher. Hunt casters/isolated PCs, use Voice Stealer to interrupt key verbal spells, and keep pressure on anyone trying to reach the Supervisor. Iron Ring 2/day.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: Three Unarmed Strike attacks. If all three hit the same creature, target is Dazed until end of its next turn.

Actions.name: Unarmed Strike
Actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) bludgeoning.

LegendaryActions.name: Party Tactics
LegendaryActions.text: Qar and each ally within 60 ft who can see or hear can move up to their speed.

BonusActions.name: Iron Ring
BonusActions.text: 2/day. Teleport to/from the Cyst as described in the stat block.

Reactions.name: No Survivors
Reactions.text: When Qar can see an enemy drop to 0 HP, Qar moves up to his Speed. If he ends within 5 ft. of an enemy, he can make an Unarmed Strike.

Reactions.name: Voice Stealer
Reactions.text: 3/day. When an enemy Qar can hear within 30 ft. finishes casting a spell with a verbal component, it must succeed on DC 15 Intelligence save or be unable to speak for 1 minute (save ends end of turn).

Traits.name: Exploit Opening (3/Day)
Traits.text: When Canon makes an attack, he has Advantage on the attack roll.

Description: Controller/support. Use Star of Iron to punish movement and Unholy Fire to catch clustered PCs. Blessing of Ajax can restore an important BIP member. Iron Ring 2/day.

Actions.name: Star of Iron
Actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning; if target is a creature, it is hexed until end of its next turn. Whenever a hexed creature makes an attack roll or saving throw, roll d4 and subtract it.

Actions.name: Unholy Fire
Actions.text: 2/day; 3rd-level spell. 15-foot-radius, 30-foot-high cylinder within 90 ft.; DC 15 Dexterity save. Fail: 14 (4d6) fire + 14 (4d6) necrotic and move 15 ft. horizontally; success: half damage and no movement.

LegendaryActions.name: Curse of Iron
LegendaryActions.text: Unleashes a magic hex. Each enemy he can see within 30ft must make DC 15 WIS save. On fail, takes 4d6 necrotic and is blinded for 1 minute (save ends at end of turn). On a successful save, half damage and not blinded.

BonusActions.name: Blessing of Ajax
BonusActions.text: 2/day. Creature within 30 ft. regains 14 (2d8) HP and ends one of blinded, charmed, dazed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, or stunned.

BonusActions.name: Iron Ring
BonusActions.text: 2/day. Teleport to/from the Cyst as described in the stat block.
